topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the course context, and the learning objectives for the session on cancer causation.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology: Endogenous Factors, Genetics, and Environmental Exposures
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the origins of cancer by evaluating the balance between endogenous cellular errors, inherited genetic predispositions, and environmental influences supported by epidemiological data.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Agents of Carcinogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how specific biological, chemical, and physical agents drive neoplastic transformation through direct mutagenesis, xenobiotic metabolism, and tumor promotion.

topics.label: Methodologies for Determining and Proving Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the genomic, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro experimental approaches used to identify and confirm carcinogenic agents.

topics.label: Conclusion and Risk Assessment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary on evaluating carcinogenic risks and benefits in everyday life.
